summary: PV1R-01, PV1R-04 and PV1R-05 are fixed. PV1R-02 and PV1R-03 remain partially fixed: their new final checks can themselves wait across expiry while retaining an earlier clock sample. The fix also introduces an I3 wait after instruction/details expiry checks, allowing expired instructions to be disclosed. No reviewer omissions are added; the disclosed separate-lane issues are excluded.
verify_observed: Supplied receipts report Linux focused verification on 90b6833: exit 0, matrix 8/8, persistence 30/30, API 42/42, ach-route-cells 79/79, no failures. The referenced Linux log and verify.log are unavailable in this checkout, so those counts were not independently observed. Read evidence.md first and checked source, test assertions, harness placement and documented revert proofs; did not repeat builder runs. Six dependency-free source probes reproduced instruction expiry, details expiry, pre-commit proof expiry, pre-commit details expiry, session idle expiry and session absolute expiry gaps. These executed the actual extracted functions with controlled collaborators, not PostgreSQL integration tests.

findings.title: Owner POST authentication bypass and lost credential refusals are fixed
findings.reproduction: Checked the complete original scope: bank POSTs now call kit.subjectOrRefusal before handlers; both reads use the same boundary; I3 reauthentication passes request.method. server.ts:582 preserves the method and :590 preserves typed refusals. ach-route-cells.test.ts:2000 exercises each of CMD201–205 with four Origin/fetch-site refusals, two CSRF refusals and credential ambiguity, asserting no journal reservation and unchanged footprint; :2029 covers ambiguity and positive controls on both reads. The fix-proof document records six failures when server.ts, bank-route-routes.ts and composition.ts are reverted.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Every cookie-authenticated owner POST must satisfy the unsafe-request Origin, fetch-site and session CSRF requirements before any command effect or journal reservation. Invalid requests must retain the prescribed refusal reason and leave no route, version, participant, event, outbox or committed journal footprint. Credential ambiguity must retain its prescribed refusal on both command and read routes.
findings.failing_test: Existing PV1R-01 tests in ach-route-cells.test.ts cover all five valid prepared commands with missing/foreign Origin, cross-site/same-site fetch, missing/wrong CSRF and cookie plus bearer; assert exact refusal, unchanged footprint and absent journal. Both reads assert AMBIGUOUS_CREDENTIALS and cookie-only success. Documented fix reversion yields 0 pass / 6 fail, beginning with configure returning 201 instead of ORIGIN_REJECTED.

findings.title: Final I3 authentication can still admit a session that expires during its own wait
findings.reproduction: Verified the original route-lock counterexample is repaired: ach-route-cells.test.ts:2049 proves the real FOR SHARE wait and exercises live, revoked and expired sessions; the documented reversion returns 200 instead of 401. However, the added final callback awaits kit.authentication, which reaches SessionService.resume. service.ts:203 samples now before awaiting the session store and :205 judges liveness at that retained sample. Delay the final resume's pool acquisition/store completion from just before idle or absolute expiry until just after it, leaving revocation and route/order eligibility unchanged. Both the store predicates and service liveness decision use the earlier time, so the callback returns true and I3 discloses secrets. Source probes executing the actual resume method returned user at time 1001 for sessions expiring at 1000 after sampling 999. The submitted cell does not hold this final authentication wait. This verifies the original session-expiry acceptance criterion, rather than adding a separate finding.
findings.acceptance_criterion: An I3 session that expires or is revoked before the projection finishes acquiring and checking its guards must receive the authentication refusal without account digits, routing digits or payment reference. This must hold for waits after the artifact read as well as during it.
findings.failing_test: Retain the existing PV1R-02 route-lock cell. Add separate idle-expiry and absolute-expiry cases that allow initial authentication and the first I3 reauthentication to finish, hold the final authentication's actual session-store operation after its clock sample, cross session expiry, and release within normal timeouts. Assert the held I3 returns 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED with no account/routing digits or reference and agrees with the next request. Include a session whose expiry remains beyond release. The expiry cases currently disclose instructions.

findings.title: Pre-commit expiry checks still sample time before their final proof-read wait
findings.reproduction: Checked all four registrations, both details-validity paths, runtime journal/security writes and the factory rollback path. points.ts:256 places the existing hold inside work, before unit-of-work.ts:483 runs the registered checks. Tests at ach-route-cells.test.ts:2149, :2164, :2216 and :2232 cover the stated eight scenarios, with documented 0 pass / 8 fail on reversion. The remaining gap is inside judgedAtCommit: it samples effectNow and checks details before await assureAt. The actual assurance verifier then awaits identities.getOwnProof before comparing freshness against the supplied earlier instant. Let the command reach this final proof read with t=expiry-1 ms; hold its SQL response/completion until expiry+1 ms, then release within statement timeout. A proof-only case is judged FRESH, and a details-only case never rechecks details. runBeforeCommit therefore returns and the factory proceeds to COMMIT after expiry. Source probes executing the actual callback and actual assurance verifier reproduced both cases without a refusal. The submitted tests hold before this callback, not during its last I/O.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Every owner command requiring step-up must have unexpired authority at its committed effect. Verification and enabling must also reject details that have expired before that effect. Crossing either required boundary during later work must leave the entire command footprint and journal uncommitted.
findings.failing_test: For verify, enable, disable and replace-details, prepare valid state and proof, allow handler/journal/security writes and the pre-commit effect clock read to finish, then hold the actual final getOwnProof SQL completion. Cross proof expiry and release; assert STEP_UP_STALE and unchanged route/version/participant/event/outbox/ALLOW footprint with no journal entry. Repeat details-only expiry for verify and enable while proof remains fresh, asserting DETAILS_EXPIRED. Include controls releasing before expiry. These cases currently permit COMMIT; the existing eight submitted tests do not inject this wait.

findings.title: KIT CHECK vocabulary evidence now establishes exact per-column sets
findings.reproduction: Checked ENUM_COLUMNS against every original migration scope entry. enumChecks at :164 reads each individual constraint; vocabularyGaps at :186 rejects extras, omissions, duplicates, unmapped columns and absent/multiple mapped checks. The exact-set test at :208 and scratch-schema mutation self-test at :213 use that same comparison. Mutations add BOGUS to each mapped constraint and remove each token where a nonempty set remains, including tokens retained elsewhere. The red-evidence document records substitution of the old global search yielding [] instead of the expected BOGUS diagnostic. The schema itself remains unchanged and conforming.
findings.acceptance_criterion: The CHECK-vocabulary conformance claim must establish each mapped column's exact intended permitted set, including explicitly limited subsets. An extra value or missing legitimate value in any individual constraint must make the check fail, even when that token occurs in another table or constraint.
findings.failing_test: Existing PV1R-04 mutation self-test creates conforming scratch copies, adds BOGUS to every mapped CHECK, removes legitimate values individually and asserts exact per-column diagnostics. It asserts that masked removals were exercised. The documented old-comparator substitution fails the added-token assertion; current exact comparison passes according to supplied evidence.

findings.title: Refund ownership and generated matrix gate are repaired
findings.reproduction: Checked all five candidate manual Refund transitions against the four new EDGE_OWNERS entries and generated matrix rows. Entries name L-REFUND, explicitly say planned/not implemented and contain no command. tools/test/matrix.test.mjs:91 independently imports the candidate Refund machine, checks every event and both manual_return_recorded transitions; :115 checks generator completion and actual matrix-check exit status. The documented revert proof reports 1 pass / 7 fail without the owner fix, and supplied focused receipts report matrix 8/8 and exit 0. The raw Linux log was unavailable.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Before merge, every candidate Refund transition must have a truthful authority/ownership and execution-status entry consistent with the registry and committed matrix. Matrix checking must complete successfully, and the candidate must pass that required verify gate. Future lane ownership must not be represented as implemented execution.

findings.title: New final authentication wait lets I3 disclose expired instructions
findings.reproduction: The fix adds await stillAuthenticated after effectNow and both details/instruction deadline comparisons at :309–311. Use a live session whose own expiry is well beyond the instruction deadline. Let I3 complete its route/order guards and sample t=deadline-1 ms, then delay the newly added final authentication's session-store connection acquisition or completion until deadline+1 ms. Authentication succeeds, and there is no subsequent instruction/details time judgment before constructing the secret-bearing view. Repeat with details.validUntil as the crossed boundary while transferExpiresAt remains later. Source probes executing actual readTransferInstructions returned READ with account digits and reference at 1001 after each boundary of 1000, despite the only effect clock read returning 999. This wait is newly introduced by 031c0e2 and makes the I3 expiry outcome false.
findings.acceptance_criterion: I3 must not disclose account digits, routing digits or payment reference when the instruction deadline or required details validity expires during its final authentication wait. The response must carry the prescribed expiry refusal, including when the session itself remains live.
findings.failing_test: In a sessions-enabled bankWorld, prepare an enabled eligible route and AWAITING_TRANSFER order with a short future instruction deadline and a long-lived session. Permit initial authentication, first I3 reauthentication, route/order guards and effect-time judgment to finish; hold the actual final session authentication operation, cross the instruction deadline and release. Assert 409 PRECONDITION_FAILED INSTRUCTIONS_EXPIRED and no account/routing digits or reference. Separately cross details.validUntil with a later instruction deadline and assert INSTRUCTIONS_NOT_AVAILABLE without secrets. Include before-expiry release controls. Both crossing cases currently return instructions.
